\documentclass[paper={a5paper},maintitle={Lyric Space Test}]{ulsbs-songbook}
\makeatletter
\newdimen\ULtestfitwidth
\newcount\ULtestlyriccalls
\newcommand{\ULtestlyric}{\global\advance\ULtestlyriccalls by 1 happy tune}
\ifUL@pdflayers
  \directlua{
    local fit = ulsbs_multikey.fit_chords
    local attribute = luatexbase.attributes["ulsbs.multikey.chord_width"]
    local natural = luatexbase.attributes["ulsbs.multikey.alternate_width"]
    local function record(box, spare)
      for n in node.traverse(box.head) do
        if n.id == node.id("hlist") then
          local original = node.has_attribute(n, attribute)
          if original then
            for matrix in node.traverse(n.head) do
              if matrix.id == node.id("whatsit") and matrix.subtype == node.subtype("pdf_setmatrix") then
                texio.write_nl("ULSBS-FIT:" .. token.get_macro("ULtestcase") .. ":"
                  .. original .. ":" .. node.has_attribute(n, natural) .. ":"
                  .. spare .. ":" .. matrix.data:match("^[^ ]+") .. ";")
              end
            end
          else
            record(n, spare)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    ulsbs_multikey.fit_chords = function(number, lyrics, minimum)
      local box = tex.box[number]
      local width, height, depth = box.width, box.height, box.depth
      fit(number, lyrics, minimum)
      assert(box.width == width and box.height == height and box.depth == depth)
      record(box, lyrics - width)
    end
  }
\fi
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\makeatletter
\sbox\UL@pdfbasebox{\ulChordFont C\shrp}
\ULtestfitwidth=.9\wd\UL@pdfbasebox
\sbox\UL@pdfbasebox{\ulChordFont\kern.2em}
\advance\ULtestfitwidth by \wd\UL@pdfbasebox
\makeatother
\begin{songs}{}
\beginsong{Lyric Space}[id={fixture-1},key={C}]
  \def\ULtestcase{example}
  \beginverse
    Please \[C]sing \[C]a \[C]{\ULtestlyric}.
  \endverse
  \def\ULtestcase{partial}
  \beginverse
    \[C]{\makebox[\ULtestfitwidth][l]{i}} fit.
  \endverse
  \def\ULtestcase{adjacent}
  \beginverse
    \[C]\[C]{wide words}.
  \endverse
  \def\ULtestcase{split}
  \beginverse
    \[C\ac{1}{G}C]{shared middle}.
  \endverse
  \def\ULtestcase{suffix}
  \beginverse
    \[C\ac{1}{G}]{shared suffix}.
  \endverse
  \newchords{lyricspace}
  \def\ULtestcase{stored}
  \beginverse\memorize[lyricspace]
    \[C]i.
  \endverse
  \def\ULtestcase{replay}
  \beginverse\replay[lyricspace]
    ^{replayed phrase}.
  \endverse
  \newchords{lyricspacepair}
  \def\ULtestcase{storedpair}
  \beginverse\memorize[lyricspacepair]
    \[C]i \[C]i.
  \endverse
  \def\ULtestcase{repeat}
  \beginverse\replay[lyricspacepair]
    This ^is another ^verse.
  \endverse
  \def\ULtestcase{empty}
  \beginverse
    \[C]
  \endverse
\endsong
\end{songs}
\typeout{ULSBS-LYRIC-CALLS:\the\ULtestlyriccalls}
\end{document}
